library_preparation_preflight.summary: Meaningful coverage requires a SQL Server integration test with an explicit JDBC driver and database container.

deterministic_setup.reason: Flyway SQL Server 13.5.0 does not include the JDBC driver; the existing scaffold already uses this repository-supported driver version. Flyway documents the driver as a separate dependency. [Flyway SQL Server documentation](https://documentation.red-gate.com/fd/sql-server-database-277579330.html)
The integration test must execute migrations against a real SQL Server instance; reuse the exact tag already pinned by the repository allow-list.

library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: Generate an integration test that starts the declared SQL Server container, waits until localhost:1433 accepts SQL authentication, runs Flyway migrations through SQLServerDataSource, asserts migration results, and reliably stops the process. Preserve explicit migration-resource handling for Native Image because generic classpath resource enumeration is insufficient; include the migration SQL resources in native-image metadata. Microsoft documents that both SQL Server and the JDBC driver are required for connections. [Microsoft JDBC documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sql/connect/jdbc/using-the-jdbc-driver?view=sql-server-ver16)
risks: The test requires Docker and exclusive host port 1433.
The issue reproducer references a different tested version than the stated 13.5.0 target; local Gradle and Native Image verification should use the actual target coordinate.
